review_candidates.title: Product Manager
review_candidates.description: Product Manager Discovery, shaping and product leadership Location: Remote, UK Type: Full-time Salary: Up to £80,000 Fully remote, with travel to vet practices, conferences and team meetings in Southampton or London. Team meetings take place once a month. About Digital Practice At Digital Practice, we're transforming how veterinary practices connect with their clients, bringing messaging, automation, bookings, payments, pricing and AI together in one platform, deeply integrated with veterinary practice management systems. Our ambition is to become the intelligent client engagement layer for veterinary practices globally, automating more of the routine work around every client and patient interaction so veterinary teams can focus on what they do best: caring for animals. Launched in 2021, we have scaled rapidly to support over 1,200 veterinary clinics and grooming salons across seven countries. Role summary We're looking for an experienced Product Manager to join and lead our growing product team. The role sits at the critical point between product vision and product delivery, turning customer problems, market opportunities and business priorities into well-considered product solutions before they move into detailed definition and delivery. Digital Practice has exceptionally close relationships with its customers and a strong founder-led product vision. Your role is to bring rigorous product craft around that insight: investigate problems, challenge assumptions, talk to customers, explore solutions, prototype ideas and determine the simplest valuable thing we could build. We're also embracing AI both within our products and within the way we work. You'll be expected to use AI confidently as part of your own product practice, from research and analysis through to prototyping and experimentation, while helping us identify where AI can genuinely improve the experience for veterinary teams and pet owners. What you'll doDiscover the right problems Lead product discovery across customer needs, commercial opportunities and internal ideas. Spend time with veterinary practices and internal teams understanding how people work today and where the real problems lie. Use quantitative product and customer data alongside qualitative research to understand behaviour, identify problems and spot opportunities. Distinguish between what customers ask for and what they actually need. Ask the difficult product questions: What problem are we solving? For whom? Why does it matter? Should we solve it? What is the smallest valuable thing we could build? Shape great products Lead the exploration and shaping of potential solutions. Develop user flows, prototypes and concepts to test ideas before committing significant engineering resource. Work closely with the CEO, Product Owner, Engineering and Design to challenge and improve product concepts. Use AI and rapid prototyping tools to explore, test and communicate product ideas quickly before committing engineering resource. Identify opportunities where AI can meaningfully automate work or improve the customer experience, while being equally comfortable deciding when AI is not the right solution. Bring strong product and UX judgement, while being comfortable having ideas challenged and improved collaboratively. Keep solutions simple and coherent, resisting unnecessary complexity and scope growth. Help maintain coherence across the platform as we expand across communications, automation, bookings, payments, pricing and AI. Recommend what we build Make evidence-based recommendations about what we should build, change or defer. Balance customer value, commercial opportunity, strategic importance, technical complexity and available resource. Define intended outcomes and measures of success for product initiatives. Lead alignment and demonstrations with senior stakeholders before significant development begins. Lead and enable the product team Line manage and build a strong partnership with our experienced Product Owner, ensuring priorities, development and support are clear. Learn and improve Review how new products perform once they reach customers. Analyse product data, customer feedback and real-world usage to identify improvements. Support pilots and early rollouts where close observation can help us learn. Feed learning back into future discovery and prioritisation. What we're looking for Strong experience as a Product Manager, Senior Product Manager, Product Lead or similar, ideally within a fast-moving SaaS business. Exceptional product judgement and a strong instinct for simplifying complex problems. Evidence of taking ambiguous customer or business problems and turning them into elegant, successful product solutions. Strong product discovery skills, including customer interviews, data analysis, problem framing, prototyping, validation and defining MVPs. Excellent UX instincts and the confidence to challenge proposed solutions and ask 'why?' before moving to 'how?'. Strong analytical thinking and an ability to use data alongside qualitative customer insight. Excellent communication skills, particularly the ability to translate between customers, commercial teams, product and engineers. Comfort with ambiguity, autonomy and the pace of a growing business. Experience with tools such as Linear, Notion, Balsamiq and Figma is useful. Experience in veterinary, healthcare, communications, workflow software, payments or AI-enabled products would be valuable, but is not essential. Most importantly, you'll create the bridge between the huge amount we learn from our customers and market, and the products we ultimately put in their hands. To apply Please complete our online application form: https://forms.cloud.microsoft/e/veyWWZxkW5 We are not currently accepting submissions from agencies.

Tester et mettre en service les moyens Réaliser les essais des équipements dans nos ateliers ; Participer à la mise au point et à la mise en service des installations ; Identifier et résoudre les dysfonctionnements électriques et automatismes ; Apporter votre expertise lors des phases de démarrage ; Accompagner les équipes dans la résolution des problématiques techniques ; Capitaliser les connaissances et les retours d’expérience issus des projets. Contribuer à l’amélioration des moyens industriels Participer aux activités de R&D visant à optimiser les procédés de fabrication ; Proposer des solutions permettant d’améliorer la performance et la fiabilité des installations ; Participer à la standardisation des solutions électriques et automatismes ; Travailler en interface avec les équipes Production, Maintenance, Qualité, Mécanique, Systèmes, Data et les fournisseurs. Votre profil : Vous êtes titulaire d’un Bac+5, diplôme d’ingénieur ou Master , avec une spécialisation en automatisme, génie électrique, électrotechnique, systèmes industriels, mécatronique ou domaine équivalent . Vous justifiez d’une expérience professionnelle d’au moins 3 ans en électricité et automatismes industriels , idéalement acquise dans un environnement de machines spéciales, moyens industriels ou lignes de production automatisées . Vous disposez de solides compétences dans plusieurs des domaines suivants : Programmation d’automates Siemens ; TIA Portal et Step 7 ; Ladder, Grafcet et SCL ; Automatismes de sécurité / Safety ; Étude et dimensionnement électrique ; Lecture et réalisation de schémas électriques et pneumatiques ; EPLAN ; IHM WinCC / Unified ; Réseaux industriels : PROFINET, PROFISAFE, IO-Link, TCP, AS-i ; Analyse fonctionnelle et analyse de risques ; Diagnostic et résolution de pannes. La connaissance des environnements Sinumerik 840D sl / Sinumerik One , de la robotique KUKA ainsi que des équipements de vision industrielle Cognex, Datalogic ou Keyence constitue un atout. Autonome, rigoureux(se) et force de proposition, vous disposez d’un bon esprit d’analyse et savez identifier les causes d’un dysfonctionnement afin de proposer des solutions techniques adaptées. Votre bon relationnel vous permet de travailler efficacement avec des équipes multidisciplinaires et des fournisseurs. Qui sommes-nous ? Joint-venture entre les groupes Stellantis et Nidec, Emotors développe en permanence son expertise afin de dessiner l'avenir de l'industrie automobile. De la création à la fabrication, nos savoir-faire pointus nous permettent la mise sur le marché de moteurs de pointe qui équiperont les véhicules électriques et hybrides de demain. Aujourd'hui près de 700 collaborateurs travaillent conjointement sur nos sites pour faire de cette co-entreprise un succès et œuvrer à long terme pour la planète. Plus de 90% de nos collaborateurs apprécient l'ambiance de travail qui existe chez Emotors : groupe à taille humaine avec des petites équipes, managers bienveillants, échanges d'expertise entre collaborateurs passionnés, voilà ce qui définit l'esprit Emotors. Vous cherchez du sens et de l’excellence ? Vous avez envie de participer au succès de notre projet ? Rejoignez-nous !
